tool.name: Mesh Tally Mapper
tool.description: Convert OpenMC mesh tallies to MOOSE-ready EXODUS format

param.name: heating_input
param.label: Heating mesh CSV (from OpenMC)
param.help: heating.csv output from the OpenMC TBR simulation tool

param.name: dpa_input
param.label: DPA mesh CSV (from OpenMC)
param.help: dpa.csv output from the OpenMC TBR simulation tool

tool.help:
**Mesh Tally Mapper**
Converts OpenMC mesh tally CSV outputs into EXODUS II format for direct use in MOOSE and TMAP8.
**Inputs**
- Heating mesh CSV — volumetric heat deposition from the OpenMC tool - DPA mesh CSV — damage energy field from the OpenMC tool
**Outputs**
- Heating EXODUS (.e) — hex8 mesh with heating field, native MOOSE format - DPA EXODUS (.e) — hex8 mesh with damage energy field, native MOOSE format
**Workflow position**::
OpenMC TBR Simulation → heating.csv + dpa.csv → Mesh Tally Mapper → heating.e + dpa.e → MOOSE / TMAP8
